text: Resizable Settings 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面插件，通过客户端模块加载器为设置弹窗添加拖动控件。用户可以从弹窗边缘和四角调整宽高，也能拖动顶部横带移动位置；双击任一缩放边缘可恢复默认布局。插件会将弹窗的位置和尺寸保存在浏览器本地存储，并在再次打开或应用重启后恢复，同时限制弹窗不越出视口或窗口顶栏。适合希望调整设置面板大小和位置的 DSH 用户；代码未要求 API 密钥或外部服务。

Resizable Settings adds drag controls to the DSH web Settings dialog. Drag its edges or corners to resize, or the top strip to move it; double-press an edge to reset. The panel size and position are saved in browser local storage and restored when reopened, within viewport limits.
想把 DSH 的设置窗口拉宽一点
设置弹窗能不能拖到屏幕另一边？
Can I resize the Settings dialog by dragging its corners?
Resizable Settings 的功能「拖动缩放设置弹窗」：用户可拖动弹窗八条边缘或四角调整宽高，最小尺寸和视口边界会限制可缩放范围。双击任一缩放区域会清除自定义尺寸并恢复默认布局。
Resizable Settings 的功能「移动并记忆设置弹窗」：拖动弹窗顶部横带可在视口内移动面板；每次拖动结束后保存位置和尺寸，下次打开时恢复并按当前视口重新约束。

dsh-resizable-settings README · dsh-resizable-settings：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Makes the Settings dialog that opens from the settings button **resizable by dragging its edges and corners**, and **movable by dragging its top strip**.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Interaction：| Action | Where |
|---|---|
| Change the width | Left/right edge (a 6px band just inside the panel) |
| Change the height | Top/bottom edge |
| Change both | The four corners (16×16) |
| Move it elsewhere | The panel's **top 20px strip** (the empty space above the header) |
| Restore the default size and position | **Press twice** on any band |

Hovering an edge turns the pointer into the matching resize cursor and lights up a thin line, so the handles are easy to find.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Interaction：The draggable area stops at the **bottom of DSH's top bar**: the panel's top edge can go no higher than the caption's lower edge, so it can never be dragged into the top bar and get stuck there.

Size and position are remembered — across the next open, and across an app restart.

dsh-resizable-settings README · How it works：The dialog is rendered by `ui-settings-general` as a modal panel with `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`, inside a fixed, flex-centred overlay; the panel itself is hard-coded to `width:800px` and has no resize affordance.

A few things have to be exactly right:

dsh-resizable-settings README · How it works：- **The handles must be drawn inside the panel.** The panel is `overflow:hidden`, so handles drawn outside its box are clipped — invisible and unclickable.
- **Freeze the panel before dragging.** Flex centring means growing it expands both sides at once, so the first press converts the panel to `position:absolute` with explicit `left/top/width/height` taken from its current `getBoundingClientRect()`. After that **the grabbed edge follows the pointer while the opposite edge stays put**.
- **The ceiling is the viewport, not a constant.** Dragging east grows until "the right edge reaches the viewport margin"; the ceiling depends on where the left edge is. That way a drag can never push the panel off screen, and hitting the ceiling never makes the anchored edge jump.
- **The top boundary is the lower edge of DSH's top bar, not the top of the viewport.** On Windows the caption is a 40px `-webkit-app-region: drag` strip, and the caption menubar host sits at `z-index:1100`, **above this modal's `1000`** — a pointer landing on that strip is consumed by window dragging or the menubar and never reaches the panel. So once the panel parks there, its

dsh-resizable-settings README · How it works：The panel is a React portal that is re-mounted on every open and close, so the handles are attached by a `MutationObserver` (scans are coalesced per frame so they do not follow every change the whole app makes); when the panel is removed, the handles go with it.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Install：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/funswe/dsh-resizable-settings
& "<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "<the cloned directory>"
```

Then restart DSH Desktop.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Tests：The harness implements just enough of `getBoundingClientRect`, `style` and `pointerdown/move/up`, runs the real bundle, and asserts the **resize arithmetic** line by line: each of the four edges only affects its own axis, a south-east drag leaves the origin alone, a north-west drag moves the origin and shrinks, the minimum-size floor, the ceiling following the viewport and the anchored edge, the anchored edge holding still when a drag hits the floor, moves clamped by the viewport, double-press reset, restore on reopen, and teardown.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Tests：The top-bar floor has its own cases: with no top bar the move grip still reaches the 12px margin, with a 40px top bar it stops at 40px, a north drag cannot push the panel back into the top bar, and a box stored inside the top bar is pulled back below it on the next open.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Package layout：| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `lib/client.js` | The browser half: all the logic lives here, hand-written rather than built |
| `lib/index.js` | The host half: an empty implementation that exists only so the plugin owns a Loader row |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The bundle patch, pointed at by `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` |
| `locale/*.json` | The title and description shown in the plugin list (`meta.title` / `meta.description`) |
| `test/resize.test.mjs` | The offline harness |

dsh-resizable-settings README · Package layout：`locale/` has two easy-to-miss constraints. DSH treats `locale/en.json` as the **anchor**: if it cannot be read, no language file in that directory is read at all (so the English one must exist). File names must be language ids (`en`, `zh`, `zh-CN`). And the files are fetched through Node's ESM resolver, so they must be allowed in `package.json`'s `exports` (`"./locale/*.json"`) and listed in `files` to reach the published package — missing either does not raise an error, it just falls back to the English description in the list.

dsh-resizable-settings README · Limits：- It only touches the Settings modal (`[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]` whose class contains `_panel`). Other dialogs are unaffected.
- The panel's own layout, behaviour and shortcuts are unchanged; it only gains draggable edges and a top strip.
- The size is stored in the browser's `localStorage` (key `dsh-resizable-settings.v1`), independently per machine and browser.
- If a DSH upgrade changes the settings panel's structure (no longer `role="dialog"` plus an inline `_panel` class), the handles will not find the panel and the plugin silently does nothing — it raises no error and does not break the settings page.
